No active mechanical/anatomical blocker; replaced A.K.Bir resolves ambiguity. Recurrent hands, thresholds and seating are thematic repetitions with distinct compositions, not duplicate images. Preserve fit-only skips; do not force all29 into books or create art-only leaves.
